records.Name: Carbon
records.GalleryTxt: Fluffington crew member. This aloof black fancy feline is always striking purrfectly elegant poses for the paw-parazzi.

records.Name: Crispy
records.GalleryTxt: Meet the laid-back Cream Siamese, a member of the Fluffington crew, who enjoys taking its sweet time grooming its paws.

records.Name: Calico Cat
records.GalleryTxt: You’ll often spot this yellow, black, and white cat around Nova, strutting around with its sassy attitude, always cuddling up to strangers and ready to play.

records.Name: Shamisen
records.GalleryTxt: Fluffington crew member. This lively Calico Cat is all about those belly rubs, flipping over for some love like a true furball superstar.

records.Name: PV猫
records.GalleryTxt: 在小广场出没的野猫

records.Name: White Cat
records.GalleryTxt: White cats are all over Nova. They’re usually super friendly and total people-lovers. Big fans of drinking water, pretty chill, and always up for a snuggle session.

records.Name: Cream Siamese
records.GalleryTxt: These cats are all about living in the “lap” of luxury, with a taste for salmon sticks almost as strong as their love for rubbing up against their favorite humans.
records.Area: Around the Stadium and Coastal Zone

records.Name: Black-and-white Collie
records.GalleryTxt: With a spirit for adventure, these cats are always on the prowl, making them the “purr-fect” blend of mysterious guardian and cuddly companion.
records.Area: Downtown, Coastal Zone, and Portview Lane residential area

records.Name: Dark Siamese
records.GalleryTxt: Elegant yet loud, they are the foodies of the feline world—hook them up with some treats, and you’ll be their purr-fect mate.

records.Name: Black Cat
records.GalleryTxt: Straight-up ice-cool, not even flinching at humans. Acts like it’s running the show, and we’re just the crew. If you’re lucky, it might slide you a bit of affection when it’s in the mood.

records.Name: Yellow Cat
records.GalleryTxt: All about the outdoor life, from “claw-some” tree climbing to fishing like a pro, adventure always is just a whisker away. If you see it lounging around, it’s either food coma time or catching some Z’s.

records.Name: Blue Cat
records.GalleryTxt: Pretty rare in Nova and a total “scaredy-cat.” Intrigued by the human hustle but too shy to join, they love watching humans shred on skateboards from a safe spot.

records.Name: Mackerel
records.GalleryTxt: Buff, brave, and super active. Parkour champions of the urban jungle, proving that life is just a series of leaps and bounds (and naps) from one adventure to the next.

records.Name: Cow Cat
records.GalleryTxt: With an energy that’s “un-leashed,” this furball is always ready to bite into life (and anything else—boxes, shoes, even tires, you name it) proving that sometimes the best things are chewed up and covered in drool. Approach with love, but be ready for spirited play.

records.Name: Orange Cat
records.GalleryTxt: Common cat with a serious appetite for life (and grub). They’re always munching or heading to chow down. Give ’em a treat, and you’re instantly besties. They’ve mastered the art of mooching food like pros.

records.Name: Blue-and-White Cat
records.GalleryTxt: Super chill and all about the snuggles—just don’t freak it out or go overboard on the hugs. When it’s hungry, you’ll see it hanging around schools, always on the prowl for snacks.

records.Name: Orange Tabby Cat
records.GalleryTxt: Rocking a yellow-brown coat with bold black stripes and a heart as wild as the wind, this cat is all about the great outdoors. Always ready for an adventure-filled chase or a laid-back sun-soaking session in nature’s warm embrace.

records.Name: Silver Tabby
records.GalleryTxt: This tank of a kitty is all about the action. A favorite among families for its child-friendly playful nature and love for outdoor adventures.

records.Name: Yellow Short-Haired Dog
records.GalleryTxt: This common yellow dog is the definition of joy, always ready for a belly rub or back scratches. Does a cute little spin before flopping down for a nap.

records.Name: White Short-Haired Dog
records.GalleryTxt: This chill white pooch is everywhere in town. Smart and independent, ready to be by your side through thick and thin.

records.Name: Black Short-Haired Dog
records.GalleryTxt: This all-black doggo with half-floppy ears and a curly tail is a total bundle of joy. Always smiling and bouncing around, proving that every day is a “paws-ibility” for happiness, no matter how “ruff” it gets.

records.Name: Brown Short-Haired Dog
records.GalleryTxt: Easygoing and mellow, this brown dog likes to take things slow. A bit of a lone wolf, but totally game for making new buddies through play and treats. Just don’t lay on the affection too thick.

records.Name: Yellow Shiba Inu
records.GalleryTxt: A yellow and white short-haired Shiba Inu with pointy ears and a curly tail. Bold, independent, and always on alert. Super playful and curious.

records.Name: Black Shiba Inu
records.GalleryTxt: This clean freak of a Shiba Inu is as chill as they come, making them the perfect low-maintenance companion.

records.Name: Brown Shiba Inu
records.GalleryTxt: Full of sass and spirit. Always on the lookout, guarding their territory with adorable determination.

records.Name: Black-and-Tan Beagle
records.GalleryTxt: A black, tan, and white Beagle with a tail that’s always perked up like a sharp scythe. Said to be bred from the larger Foxhound, they’re full of energy and ready to take on any adventure with gusto.

records.Name: Black-and-White Beagle
records.GalleryTxt: A rarer black and white Beagle, mid-sized. It’s got a cheerful personality, quick reflexes, and adorable moves. If adopted, it’ll shower you with affection.
records.Area: Portview Lane, Coastal Zone residential area

records.Name: Tan-and-White Beagle
records.GalleryTxt: A friendly mid-sized Beagle rocking a tan-and-white fur coat. Brimming with energy and sharp as a tack, often trained as a sniffer dog. Total foodie—dish out any amount of food, and it’ll gobble it all up!

records.Name: Blue-and-White Collie
records.GalleryTxt: Smart, majestic, and always ready to learn. Highly focused and enthusiastic, but without proper exercise, it can get restless and unleash mayhem.
records.Area: Around the Stadium and Coastal Zone

records.Name: Brown-and-White Collie
records.GalleryTxt: Incredibly outgoing with people, with no hostility towards strangers. Just be wary around mother dogs safeguarding their little ones. Lightning-fast reflexes, epic leaper, and overflowing with energy. Can be a bit reserved in unfamiliar spots though.
records.Area: Around Marine MechWorks and residential areas
